Browse the latest stable version defined by each container's Dockerfiles.
If that version has not been published yet, the most recently pushed Docker Hub
tag is shown instead.
Container titles link to their version README on `main` when it exists;
the Dockerfile link opens the corresponding source.
Registry badges and platforms reflect the selected tag's published images at
the time this site was rendered.
